axioms.name: Experimental.P06_03.upstream_harmonic_residual_p_integral
axioms.meaning: p-integrality of the explicitly removed finite harmonic residue.

literal_statement_repair_policy: BLOCKED_LITERAL_PART_2: the repository documents an actual h=4 negative-direction counterexample. Neither positive definiteness nor determinant decay is assumed. A corrected target needs an explicit separately approved statement.
coverage: The q-dimensional part uses the actual rational dual pencil and explicit basis coefficients. The disputed cone has explicit polynomial/mode definitions for inspection only.
remaining: For part (1), derive the scaled entry matrix and its reduction from the harmonic residual, then prove determinant valuation and rational-center nonvanishing. For part (2), do not attempt a closure of the literal claim until the documented h=4 counterexample and a replacement statement are reconciled. Finite mode annihilation is not infinite-tail positivity.
